audit.framework_rationale: TensorCircuit DMCircuit performs probe preparation, RXX gates, custom Kraus-channel application, and observable evaluation. JAX supplies differentiation and compilation; Optax supplies Adam. Neither is another quantum framework.
audit.cheating_rationale: The [REDACTED] probabilities are used only to generate the authorized synthetic target table. Fitted probabilities result from optimization. No hidden answers, evaluator exploits, or test/reward modifications appear.
audit.fidelity_rationale: The implementation constructs all four required inputs, applies even then odd entangler layers with independent Kraus channels, and measures every single-site Z and full-chain parity. It consumes the provided configuration, initializes sigmoid parameters correctly, minimizes table-wide mean squared error with exactly max_steps Adam updates, records pre-update losses, and returns the required NumPy arrays with final fitted expectations.
audit.implementation_error_rationale: No obvious implementation error is evident. Kraus matrices use the specified transition directions, probe preparations match the requested states, and the optimization and returned quantities are consistent with the task.
